instructions.title: How to connect
instructions.step1: Create conversion actions in Google Ads that match the names you want to import.
instructions.step2: Open Google Ads > Goals > Conversions and create an HTTPS data source import.
instructions.step3: Use the CSV URL shown above and enter the username and password from this page.
instructions.step4: Enable enhanced conversions in Google Ads if you want hashed email/phone matching.
